evidence_items.explanation: CSET's reanalysis supports diminishing returns on a programming measure using an assumed training-budget conversion. Its limited task coverage and extrapolations do not establish a broad trend across frontier releases around June 2024.

The report documents predictable scaling results for GPT-4, while withholding important training details. Predictable improvement can coexist with diminishing marginal returns, so this does not contradict the claim or establish its asserted contemporary trend.
